digest.component_or_area: LLM gate cost analysis and ordinal-to-binary migration planning
propositions: Per-gate LLM costs measured: plan-review $3.02/run, code-review $1.42/run, completion-verifier $2.24/run, averaging $11.85/completed ticket

Code-review severity axes are inert because 98.2% of findings route to blocking_enabled=False before severity is consulted; the 0.95 threshold is unreachable (no historical conjunction of system blast_radius + high likelihood + hard reversibility observed)

Cheap-model experiments rejected Haiku for agentic review and Nova Pro for completion-verification due to false-accepts; Nova Pro frontier swap is not viable due to Bedrock web-search tool errors and budget exhaustion

Deprecation-removal survey found one immediately-removable item (gitattributes migration arm) and two candidates for next breaking window (single-pass review surfaces and REBAR_LLM_MODEL), all others blocked by schedule or unmet conditions
AWS alarm sweep identified two new observability.sh probe defects causing false-positive metric emissions (cold-start offset seeding and over-broad grep pattern matching code review text)

Phased ordinal-to-binary migration plan recorded with three phases (remove unused emissions, convert undecomposed findings, replace ordinal ladders with binary subquestions) pending operator approval before execution
